content: {"reasoning":"The denial is for missing required prior authorization, and Silverbridge offers neither retroactive authorization nor peer-to-peer review; a medical-necessity appeal has already been attempted without resolving CO-197. Because this is a contractual-obligation denial caused by absent authorization, the balance cannot properly be shifted to the patient despite normal deductible and coinsurance terms, and no further compliant payer action remains.","action":"write_off"}
